This sample is part of the "PPG
MULTISAMPLE 006 Digital Mallet" sample pack. It is a short bell sound
with some harsh digital distorion above it, especially at the higher
pitches. In the sample pack there are 16 samples evenly spread across 5
octaves (C1 till C6). The note in the sample name (C, E or G#) does not
indicate the pitch of the sound but the key on my keyboard. The sound
was created on the PPG VSTi. After that normalising and fades where applied within Cubase SX.
